instruction:
L-Shaped Studio Flat IFC Shell

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a metric IFC4 one-storey L-shaped studio flat shell and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 3 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcDoor, 4 IfcWindow entities, 5 IfcOpeningElement entities, 5 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 5 IfcRelFillsElement relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Studio Level, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has Elevation 0.00 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly Living, Bath, and Kitchenette, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. The Living space geometry has clear plan dimensions 3.80 m by 6.00 m, in either X/Y orientation, with tolerance +/-0.08 m; the Bath and Kitchenette space geometries each have clear plan dimensions 3.00 m by 1.30 m, in either X/Y orientation, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. Each IfcSpace has geometry height 2.80 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m, and the Living space area is larger than each of the Bath and Kitchenette space areas.
10. The slabs are named exactly Floor Slab and Roof Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; each slab has plan dimensions 7.40 m by 6.40 m in either X/Y orientation and thickness 0.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m for plan dimensions and +/-0.05 m for thickness.
11. The Floor Slab and Roof Slab have matching XY bounding-box extents within +/-0.08 m.
12. The door has OverallWidth 0.95 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m and fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids an IfcWall.
13. The 4 windows each have OverallWidth 1.20 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m, and each window fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids an IfcWall.
14. Each wall has height 3.00 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m and plan thickness 0.20 m with tolerance +/-0.04 m.
15. All spaces, walls, slabs, the door, and windows are spatially assigned to Studio Level.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
